items.source: śārdūlavikrīḍita · svara by the owner's convention for the metre
items.text:
vande padmakarām prasannavadanāṁ saubhāgyadām bhāgyadāṁ
hastābhyām abhayapradāṁ maṇigaṇair nānāvidhair bhūṣitām ।
bhaktābhīṣṭaphalapradāṁ hariharabrahmādibhis sevitām
pārśve paṅkajaśaṅkhapadmanidhibhir yuktāṁ sadā śaktibhiḥ ॥

translation.en: I bow to her who holds the lotus, whose face is gracious, who gives good fortune and gives destiny; who with her two hands grants fearlessness, adorned with jewels of every kind; who grants the wish of her devotees, served by Hari, Hara, Brahmā and the rest; attended at her side, always, by the lotus, the conch, the padma treasure and her powers.

entries.note: ātmanepada

entries.meaning: her who holds the lotus in her hand
entries.note: the anusvāra assimilates to the following stop and is rendered in the change colour
the anusvāra assimilates to the following stop and is rendered in the change colour

entries.meaning: the giver of destiny, of one's allotted share

entries.note: the visarga becomes r before the voiced sound that follows
the visarga becomes r before the voiced sound that follows

entries.meaning: the giver of the fruit her devotees long for
by Hari, Hara, Brahmā and the rest
entries.note: the visarga assimilates to the following sibilant
the anusvāra assimilates to the following stop and is rendered in the change colour — here across the line break, before pārśve

entries.meaning: with the lotus, the conch and the padma treasure
entries.note: the visarga becomes r before the voiced sound that follows

items.text:
sarasija nilaye saroja haste
dhavalatamāṁśuka gandha mālya śobhe ।
bhagavati hari vallabhe manojñe
tribhuvana bhūti kari prasīda mahyam ॥

translation.en: In a lotus abode, lotus in hand, resplendent in the whitest garment, in fragrance and flower garlands; O blessed one, dear to Hari, O lovely one, maker of the wellbeing of the three worlds — be gracious to me.

entries.note: prior member of sarasija-nilayā, 'she whose abode is the lotus'

entries.meaning: O you whose abode it is

entries.note: prior member of saroja-hastā, 'lotus in hand'

entries.meaning: O you who hold it in your hand

entries.note: dhavalatama is the SUPERLATIVE — the owner's reading; the comparative dhavalatara- circulates but is not his
uninflected prior member of the compound
uninflected prior member of the compound

entries.meaning: O you who are resplendent with them

entries.note: prior member of hari-vallabhā, 'dear to Hari'

entries.meaning: O lovely one, pleasing to the mind
entries.note: the owner prints the jñ reading aid — a superscript g on the j — so it is carried as `sup` on that letter
uninflected prior member of the compound
